### Profile

I'm a quantitative researcher with a PhD and 8+ years of international research
experience, now working as a **data analyst**. I'm skilled in **Python (Pandas), SQL,
Tableau, ETL pipelines and A/B testing**, with a track record in automated data
validation, large-scale data analysis, and explaining complex findings to diverse
audiences (20+ peer-reviewed publications).

I'm looking for a Data Analyst role where I can deliver **trusted, decision-ready
insights**. I'm based in Darmstadt, open to relocation across Germany, and
available from **December 2026**.

### What I do

- Clean, validate and analyse messy real-world data with **Python and Pandas**.
- Write **SQL** queries that combine data from many tables to answer business questions.
- Design and evaluate **A/B tests** with sound statistics.
- Build **ETL pipelines** that collect data via web scraping and APIs and load it
  into cloud databases on **Google Cloud**.
- Present results in interactive **Tableau dashboards** that non-technical
  audiences can act on.

### Core skills

- **Data analysis:** Python (Pandas, NumPy), data cleaning & validation, statistical analysis, A/B testing
- **Databases & querying:** SQL, MySQL, BigQuery, REST APIs, web scraping
- **ETL & cloud:** ETL pipelines, Google Cloud (Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler)
- **Visualisation & BI:** Tableau, dashboards & business reporting, Matplotlib
- **Machine learning:** Scikit-learn, regression, classification, clustering
- **Engineering & tools:** Git/GitHub, C++, R, Linux, Docker, CI/CD, automated testing

### Training & experience

- **Data Science Bootcamp**, WBS Coding School · Jul 2026 – present
- **Self-directed data analytics study** (Google Data Analytics, Supervised ML) · Oct 2025 – Jun 2026
- **Postdoctoral Researcher – Software & Data Systems**, Goethe University Frankfurt · Mar 2023 – Sep 2025
- **Software Engineering Intern**, GSI Helmholtz Centre / FAIR · Jul 2022 – Dec 2022
- **PhD, Experimental High-Energy Physics**, Aligarh Muslim University · Dec 2015 – Dec 2022
